versions.content: In case of "event" semantic the IocSendGroup function shall re- turn IOC_E_LIMIT if an IOC internal transmission buffer got full (Case: Receiver is slower than sender or/and configured internal IOC buffer size is too small). If this error occurs the IOC Internal buffer could not be filled with the parameter. In that case this error produces an IOC_E_LOST_DATA Overlayed Error on the receiver side at the next data reception.
